_what: What there is to watch on the bodymind break, the calm screen the dial's and the CB's I need a bodymind break opens over any page: the forest Helen linked, and the jellies she asked for beside it, and then, in her words, done (2026-10-24). tools/make-bodymind-break.py writes them into bodymind-break.js between the break:films markers, and check-jukebox.py asks YouTube whether each still plays and embeds.
_source: Helen Edgar's idea, 2026-10-24: the street is busy even at Gentle, so a blank, cool screen to regulate in, saying breathe, it will be okay, with the choice of watching a forest; she linked this film. Ryan's answer the same day was Cavendish Space's I need a bodymind break button, in the CB, opening a simple, calming, biophilic overlay with this forest. The id, title, channel, runtime and the music's credit were read off the film's own watch page and description on 2026-10-24 (yt-dlp): playable, embeddable, not live, not age-limited.
_licence: NOTHING FILMED OR MUSICAL IS HOSTED HERE: the film stays on Relaxation Film's channel and is framed only when somebody presses it. Its description sells it for sleep, focus and relaxation and as 'Healing' music; none of that is repeated on the break, which says what is in it and how long it runs, and never what it will do for anybody.

Read off its watch page the same day with yt-dlp: live, playable, embeddable, not age-limited, the channel Monterey Bay Aquarium, and its description naming the Open Sea exhibit.
